free_tier.stated: No standing free inference allowance: Vertex AI / Model Garden models are billed per 1 million tokens (for example Gemini 3.8 Flash at USD 0.75 per 1M input tokens through 2026-12-31). New customers get USD 300 in Google Cloud free credit.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible endpoint and the vendor's own client; requests use a Google Cloud key
chaining: the USD 300 new-customer credit is the scarce link, not a standing free tier

limits.value: USD 300 free credit for new customers; model calls then billed per 1M tokens

identity_cost.detail: a Google Cloud account with billing; card needed for the trial credit signup

reliability_note: prices are time-boxed for some models (through 2026-12-31), with higher rates starting 2027-01-01

evidence.proved: Gemini 3.8 Flash is priced per 1M input tokens with a promotional rate through 2026-12-31
new customers get USD 300 in free credit
evidence.quote: New customers get [$300 in free credit]

notes: The doc URL's price page redirected to cloud.google.com/model-garden/pricing. No standing free inference tier is documented.
